desc:
🩸 Ragdoll Reality: a physics sandbox where every hit lands on real bones, organs and blood!

🎯 Every limb has its own physics: shove, shoot or smash and they fall their own way
🦴 Break a leg and they limp, break both and they crawl
🫀 Bullets tear through bone and organs, and hit whatever stands behind
🩸 Wounds bleed and drip, and blood pools under the body
🔎 Scan any dummy to see every injury inside
⚡ Restart a heart with the Defibrillator, or Revive everyone
✋ Grab a dummy by any limb, swing it and throw it
🔫 Unlock tools by kills: Fire Axe, Katana, Sniper, Minigun, Rocket Launcher, Taser and more
🌪️ Start events: Tsunami, Airstrike, Meteor Rain, Shark Rain, T-Rex Attack, Zombie Outbreak
🦈 Sharks, crocodiles and a T-Rex roam the map
🎡 Giant fan, crusher, cannon and a Fight Ring
💬 Dummies talk back and look after each other
🚗 Drive the Monster Truck or the Battle Tank
🧪 Sandbox Controls: fly, stop time, spawn a crowd

🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet and Console!
